_about: Sprites the game takes from FREE art packs (not LimeZu). Read by tools/import_free.py; every name under props is owned by that importer and the procedural generators stand down for it (limezu.owned_names() unions this file in). The packs are never committed -- they are found on the machine (see import_free.py) and only the finished sprites live in art/. Each pack records its licence and the credit it asks for; the credits page carries every one, required or not.

rocking_chair.why: the brown wooden lounge chair, halved onto the room's 2px grid and snapped to LimeZu's palette

hammock_chair.why: the tall brown egg chair: a hanging chair's shape without the frame

window_seat.why: the blue bench sofa -- a cushioned seat, low back, the length of a window

low_shelf.why: the low bookcase with its books and a plant on top

state_flag.why: a blue flag that waves: the first shop item from a free pack that moves

fx_rain.why: a falling raindrop's streak, three frames: wet-play weather (classroom.gd WEATHER_ART)

fx_snow.why: a snowflake that turns as it falls: cold-snap weather

fx_sparkle.why: a sparkle that flares and fades: the cleaning day's air
